Man, being 16 and doing dual enrollment while starting a job is a lot to carry. You're basically speedrunning early adulthood and that wears you down even when everything looks fine on paper.

  
That tired-sad thing that flares up when you're frustrated or lonely, it doesn't need a reason. Sometimes your brain just runs low on whatever it needs and external stuff being good doesn't refill the tank. The fact you're worried about your family and want to leave a mark tells me you've got fight left in you, you're just exhausted.

  
Talk to someone. Not your family if that feels too heavy right now, but a counselor at school, a teacher you trust, even a hotline. You don't have to figure out the "why" before you ask for help.

I think you should keep fighting for yourself. ... "You deserve a good life," my Dad said that to me when I was in a deep pain a few months ago- and I will say the same to you. 

You deserve to be well, happy & loved truly. You can find all of that, I believe. ... Tomorrow is a new day, a new day to breathe and know you love yourself and know what you need/ want out of your life.

Wishing you the best, internet friend!
